newsitem.title: USA: Vermont likely to capture budget surplus.
newsitem.headline: Vermont likely to capture budget surplus.

text.p: Vermont looks likely to end the year with a substantial budget surplus, as personal income tax revenues at the end of April were $20 million over projections.
Overall dollars are now on track to exceed projections for the fiscal year by more than $30 million.

That could be good news for lawmakers, who have spent years fighting over scarce funds and budget deficits. But legislative leaders and the Dean administration are cautioning against the temptation to spend the money.
They warn that the surplus might not represent a trend, and while income tax revenues are up, sales and corporate taxes are down.
